subject: corpus: QuartzCore compositor gate RESULT (742cdf3d/06a6c6ee): enabling CA Metal today = nil PSO -> abort; path_* need colour attachment>=2
body:
Host-only, workers=1, isolated children, no build/device. Files: gpu/build/ui-corpus-20261025/compositor-gate-20261025/{README.md,summary.json}. Entry = tegu_mali_compile_generic_pair_options DRAW_PARAMETERS|EXTENDED_VARYINGS (+SELECT_RT) + vertex-fetch coverage, as render_pipeline.inc (sha12 c68d9b2be189, edited 22:10 by render during the run; cited lines 995-1010/1758-1760/1818 unchanged). 735 AIR-compatible pairs, 231 canonical pairs, 6 fixed-UI serials, 7 kernels, 4 formats; 0 aborts, 0 base_instance/steal_tex_srcs.
RESULT: 141 funcs: fragments 95 = 72 PSO-possible, 1 fixed_frag_lph_cph (captured serials 4..9 fmt80 only), 1 fixed_frag_lph_cpf (synthetic constants only), 16 compile OK but nil by render policy (path_{cubic,rect,stroke_line,miter,round,clear}+path_blit), 2 path_stroke_curve (Vertex varying layout does not cover interface), 2 inplace_copy (storage images), 1 asg_frag_lph (graphics TLS spill; lpf builds). Kernels: compute_apl, compute_apl_fast, sum_apl compile (v2 default spec); tile_downsample_* TileAttachments (only if tile shaders). 13/13 captured blur recipes (fmt80 + RGBA16F) compile. std_vert1 builds all shading/colour frags; std_vert0_* builds NONE.
RANKED BLOCKERS (frag/pairs): 1 colour attachment index>=2 (18/24) owner render(+compute/textures RT2 R8 + input-attachment fetch): AIR shows path_* write ONLY render_target(2), path_blit writes 0,1,2; compiler OK with [BGRA,BGRA,R8]; render nord2Single=0 + fallback extra|=formats[2..7] -> nord2_render_error nil. 2 fixed_* function-constant space (missing_input; 6 serials captured) owner corpus/lowering. 3 vertex varying cover mali_graphics_compiler.c:1377 (2/32) owner lowering. 4 graphics storage image (2/4) lowering+textures. 5 graphics TLS asg_frag_lph (1/4) lowering. 6 formats outside {10,70,80,115} (bridge refuses A8,R16F,sRGB,10-bit,XR...) render+textures; warmup list unidentified. 7 tile_downsample translator. Exact-class paths (fixed r80/r85, blur3, attachment-clear) are unreachable under NORD2_JM_TRANSPORT (goto fail line 1010); generic options entry IS the path.
CORRECTION to corpus_inputs L3b: fixed_* 'Reflection' refusals came from canonical constants refused at specialize_fragment (wrong diagnostic input); with captured-baseline-derived constants cpf/gen translate+compile (synthetic, not app coverage). fixed_vert_lpf_*+fixed_frag_lph_* is a wrong pairing.
ASKS: render: QG0 non-nil inert PSO for unsupported descriptors before any backboardd Metal enable (hides, does not implement); decide RT>=2. lowering: rank-3/4/5. audit/root: QG4 identify real WarmupShaders list (formats x attachments) offline from the local dyld cache. Descriptor shapes other than 19 captured recipes/serials are INFERRED.
